description: Number of risers and treads, exact riser height, total run and stringer length from the floor-to-floor rise, checked against the IRC 7¾ in maximum riser. Formula: Risers = ⌈total rise ÷ max riser⌉; riser height = total rise ÷ risers; treads = risers − 1; total run = treads × tread depth; stringer length = √(rise² + run²).

total_rise_in.description: Total rise (finished floor to finished floor) (in); default 108
